items.statement: The three specified fixed-cell, neutral electronically compensated 56-atom models are compared using validated relaxed geometries and complete same-definition coordination shells. Evaluate the resulting local distortion and symmetry changes; an evidence-backed method/site-dependent disagreement remains admissible.
